prompt_base: Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE dialogue bust emotion variant for Terminus, based very closely on the supplied character concept. The concept is the authority for anatomy, apparent age, face geometry, hair, clothes, every accessory and design detail; do not redesign anything. Coreto style: monochrome sepia, black hand-inked outlines, dark brown crosshatching, fine stippling, light parchment highlights INSIDE the silhouette, no painted background. Keep the same stylization, relative line weights, upper-left lighting and palette as concept. ONE character only, portrait 3:4 canvas, head through waist/upper hips, complete head, ears and shoulders, hands fully within frame if shown. Leave clear transparent margins, reserve enough room for restrained gestures. Keep original facing direction and proportions. Do not add props, symbols, lettering, sweat drops, emotion icons, aura, scenery or floor shadow. Actual transparent background. Final export is 504x672; draw legibly at that scale.

direcao_emocoes.feliz: FELIZ / HAPPY. Clearly readable happiness appropriate to personality: eyes brighten and soften, cheeks lift, smile or equivalent eye expression, shoulders gently relax/open. Restrained natural gesture if useful, not an exaggerated cheer.
direcao_emocoes.triste: TRISTE / SAD. Clearly sad: inner brow/eye corners gently rise, downcast gaze, mouth corners lower when visible, head bows slightly, shoulders droop a little. Preserve age and face geometry. No streams of tears or crying icons.
direcao_emocoes.raiva: COM RAIVA / ANGRY. Clear anger: knitted/lowered brows or eye shapes, focused narrowed gaze, tense jaw/mouth when visible, squared tense shoulders. Contained confrontation rather than a battle pose; no new weapons.
direcao_emocoes.confuso: CONFUSO / CONFUSED. Clearly puzzled: asymmetric brows/eye shapes, slight head tilt, hesitant mouth when visible, small questioning palm-up gesture ONLY if natural to original visible hands. No punctuation/symbols.

invariantes.rheed: Anão idoso e corpulento; nariz largo e arredondado; cabelo branco penteado para trás; barba branca volumosa e solta, duas pontas laterais do bigode presas por anilhas e pequeno tufo inferior atado. Tapa-olho no lado direito da imagem (olho anatômico esquerdo), com cicatriz acima. Gola ampla angular ornamentada, casaco sem mangas, colete de painéis e fechos, mangas bufantes com faixas e punhos franzidos, corrente e broches. Caneca de madeira com aros metálicos na mão à direita da imagem. Nova referência do autor prevalece sobre a lateralidade da ficha anterior.
